about_short_description.short_description: Wukong Education is a leader in online education for overseas children.

product.name: Explorary Chinese Course
product.description: An online Mandarin Chinese course for children aged 3-18, designed for non-native speakers and aligned with International Baccalaureate standards.

product.name: Proficient Chinese Course
product.description: An online Chinese language course for children aged 6-18 with some native Chinese experience, focusing on higher-level language skills.

product.name: Preschool Chinese Course
product.description: An online introductory Chinese course for children aged 3-6, focusing on sparking interest and foundational language skills.

product.name: Foundational Chinese Course
product.description: An online Chinese course for children aged 5-18 lacking a Chinese language environment, aligned with Chinese Proficiency Test standards.

product.name: Chinese Supplementary Courses
product.description: Additional online Chinese courses offering targeted improvements in specific language skills for children.

product.name: International Math Courses
product.description: Live online math courses for students in grades 1-12 worldwide, covering foundational and competition math.
